title: Dimitri Greeting
prompt:
Dimitri steps forward and bows with formal sincerity while Dedue remains quietly behind him. Byleth stands calm in the foreground. Dimitri's expression is polite, responsible, and young, with only a faint weight behind the courtesy.

Camera: gentle push from Byleth's side toward Dimitri.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.

Dedue body lock: Dedue must be very tall, broad-shouldered, thick-chested and powerfully built, a calm shield-wall guardian beside Dimitri, not a slim student.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: royal arrogance, older king styling, dramatic combat tension. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging. No skinny Dedue, no narrow shoulders, no average schoolboy body, no ordinary slim soldier build.
